description: Show where a piece of content sits in its module: the previous and next items, so you can work through a module in order. Read-only.

asset_id.description: ID of that content (numeric string). For a Page, use its URL slug.

asset_type.description: Kind of content asset_id refers to. Use "ModuleItem" when asset_id is a module item ID from list_module_items.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_module_item_sequence
title: Get Module Item Sequence
